title: A Fully Automated, Deployment-Aware Testing Pipeline for IoT-Based Automotive Applications
abstract: arXiv:2608.19752v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Testing embedded software in modern vehicles is challenging due to system complexity, decentralized architectures, and strict safety and performance constraints. In this work, we present an end-to-end, deployment-aware testing pipeline for IoT-based automotive applications. The pipeline combines requirement-driven test and code generation with large language model (LLM) and vision-language model (VLM) assistance, and human-in-the-loop curation to reduce manual effort and improve consistency. Using Eclipse openDuT, it supports flexible, distributed deployment across geographically separated cyber-physical and IoT infrastructures, optimizing for node availability and cross-organizational coordination. For validation, we conduct a case study using a Child Presence Detection System (CPDS), achieving full functional requirement coverage across all 9 requirements and 100% Gherkin generation accuracy on the controlled requirement set. translated_abstract: 摘要：由于系统复杂性、分散式架构以及严格的安全和性能约束，现代车辆中嵌入式软件的测试具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种面向物联网汽车应用的端到端、部署感知的测试流水线。该流水线将需求驱动的测试和代码生成与大型语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）辅助以及人工循环整理相结合，以减少手动工作并提高一致性。利用Eclipse openDuT，它支持跨地理分离的网络物理和物联网基础设施的灵活、分布式部署，优化节点可用性和跨组织协调。为进行验证，我们使用儿童存在检测系统（CPDS）进行了案例研究，在所有9项需求上实现了完整的功能需求覆盖，并在受控需求集上实现了100%的Gherkin生成准确性。分布式...
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合大语言模型、视觉语言模型和人工审核的部署感知测试流水线，通过Eclipse openDuT实现分布式部署，并在儿童存在检测系统案例中实现了全部需求覆盖和100%的Gherkin生成准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a deployment-aware testing pipeline integrating LLMs, VLMs, and human-in-the-loop review, enabling distributed deployment via Eclipse openDuT, achieving full requirement coverage and 100% Gherkin generation accuracy in a Child Presence Detection System case study.
